senses.gloss: (v.חָלַל, חֲלַל II; cmp. Assyr. סחל to perforate, Del. Assyr. Handw., p. 493) to move in a hollow space, slip.—Part. pass. שָׁחוּל

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 15:2:3">Y. Sabb. XV, beg. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>בחבל ש׳ היא מתני׳</he> the Mishnah speaks of a rope drawn through a loop (not knotted).

Ib. חבל שהוא משוחל בפסיקיא וכ׳ if a looped rope be meant, (of which the Mishnah says,) ‘you may tie up the broken rope with a fascia, but not with a rope, but R. Judah allows’—this would imply that the Rabbis do not allow it (and why should they not?).—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: to pass through a hollow space (חַלּוֹן) or groove; to slide.
units: ib. V, 1 משילין) חד תני משילין וחד תני מַשְׁחִילִין one reads mashshilin (fr. נָשַׁל), and another reads mashḥilin, you may let fruit slide down through an aperture in the roof (אֲרוּבָּה) &c.; מאן דתני משחילין וכ׳ he that reads mashḥilin is not wrong, for we read (Bekh. VI, 7) &c., v. שָׁחוּל. Y. ib. V, beg. 62ᵈ היה … משחילין דרך חלון if there is an aperture in the roof, you may let the fruit down by the aperture. Y. Yoma II, 39ᶜ מַשְׁחִיל ותורם he lets the wood slide (down the altar), and then removes the ashes. Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ חוט שהִשְׁחִילוֹ במחט (not למחט) a thread which one threaded through the eye of a needle; Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ bot.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:32">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 41</cite> <he>ה׳ עשו עצמו וכ׳</he> Esau threaded his way through and went into the cave; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:32">ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ וצף וכ׳</he> ed. Bub., v. <cite ref="R00705"><he>צָפַף</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 606:1">Yalk. Ruth 606</cite> <he>שאלו הש׳ לה קללה אחת וכ׳</he> (later ed. <he>התחיל</he>, corr. acc.) for, if he (Boaz) had let down a single curse on her (Ruth), how could I (David) have risen?; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 63ᵃ <he>שאלו השאיל … מלמטן וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) for, if he had let down on her a single curse from above (‘below’ euphem. for ‘above’) &c.; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 17:1">Pesik. R. s. 17</cite> <he>התחיל</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 6:2">Ruth R. to III, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 6:4">s. 6</cite>, beg.) <he>החיש לה</he> (corr. acc.).—Part. pass. <he>מוּשְׁחָל</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 36">Lev. R. s. 36</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 11:21">Prov. XI, 21</cite>) <he>וזרע … שמ׳ מבין … נמלט</he> ‘the seed of righteous men’ that slips through between two righteous men (like Ahaz between a pious father and a pious son) escapes; (Y. Snh. X, 27ᵈ <he>זרע שהוא מוטל וכ׳</he>).
